name: Parlant
description: Builds customer-facing chat agents in Python that follow your policies, approved wording and tool rules, for CX teams who want support bots on their own code and models.

skills.name: Policies
skills.description: Defines plain-language policies that the engine brings into a conversation only when they apply, with the tools each may use.

skills.name: Canned Responses
skills.description: Adds approved wording examples that the agent adapts to each conversation when a policy calls for exact phrasing.

skills.name: Tool and Message Review
skills.description: Checks actions such as refunds before they run and reviews replies before they are sent to the customer.

skills.name: Human Handoff
skills.description: Hands a live conversation from the agent to your human team in the same chat widget on your website or app.

skills.name: Simulated Tests
skills.description: Runs simulated test conversations with personas and links each reply to the policies and tool calls behind it.
